Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(cli\): major refactoring with security hardening and modularization

## Phase 1: Safety & Correctness
- Fix race condition in token refresh with mutex pattern
- Add depth limit and cycle detection to findBinary\(\) recursion
- Convert config migration to lazy initialization with error handling
- Fix file descriptor leak on HTTP redirects in update-installer
- Add type guard for API error response parsing

## Phase 2: Structure & Clarity
- Modularize apikey.ts \(1,577 lines\) into 25 files in src/commands/apikey/
- Modularize secret.ts \(1,382 lines\) into 14 files in src/commands/secret/
- Modularize config.ts \(543 lines\) into 11 files in src/lib/config/
- Split VaultClient into domain clients in src/lib/client/
- Extract shared format helpers to src/lib/format-helpers.ts
- Centralize error handling in src/lib/command-error-handler.ts
- Extract magic numbers to src/lib/constants.ts

## Phase 3: Performance
- Fix N+1 query in listTenants\(\) with single query using subqueries
- Replace blocking execSync with async exec + Promise.allSettled
- Add config caching with 5-second TTL

## Security Hardening
- Fix command injection in device.ts \(use execFileSync instead of shell\)
- Fix command injection in plugin.ts \(validate package names + execFileSync\)
- Reject unsigned releases by default \(require ZNVAULT_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_RELEASES\)
- Add TLS insecure mode warning \(shown once per session\)
- Add environment variable validation with clear error messages
- Replace console.warn/error with output module in signature-verifier

## New Features
- Enhanced CLI startup display with profile, identity, and status info
- Quick commands section on startup
- Environment validation API \(validateEnvironment, assertValidEnvironment\)

All 608 tests passing. Backward compatibility maintained via re-export pattern.
EOF
\)")

Bash(git tag -a v2.17.0 -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''

Security Hardening:
- Fix command injection vulnerabilities in device.ts and plugin.ts
- Add package name validation for npm operations
- Require signature verification for releases \(ZNVAULT_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_RELEASES to override\)
- Add TLS insecure mode warning
- Add environment variable validation module

Performance Improvements:
- Fix N+1 query in listTenants\(\) with subqueries
- Replace execSync with async exec + Promise.allSettled for Redis checks
- Add config caching with 5-second TTL

Modularization:
- Split config.ts into modular structure \(types, store, migration, profile, credentials, apikey, plugins, getters, cache, validation\)
- Maintain backward compatibility via re-exports

Enhanced CLI Experience:
- Add rich startup display showing profile, identity, vault URL, and auth method
- Add quick commands section
- Support JWT and API key identity display

All 608 tests passing.
EOF
\)")
